title: Vercel cannot auto-renew a purchased domain at Frequency's cost while domain sales are paused

source.ref: Meta scan eight (2026-10-12), domains review of #3240 (LIVE-781) and #3328 (LIVE-786).

detail: FILED 2026-10-12. THE CONSEQUENCE: the purchase turns Vercel autoRenew on whenever the Space has a saved card. Only the renewal sweep turns it off, and the sweep skips registered rows with no renewal state while domain_purchase_enabled is off. With sales paused Vercel renews and bills the platform, and when sales reopen the sweep raises registry-expiration-needs-review for a renewal the Space was never charged for. THE FIX (owner call): buy with autoRenew false always, since the sweep is the intended spending path, or let the sweep run its auto-renew-off step while closed.

verify.cmd: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const r=(p)=>fs.existsSync(p)?fs.readFileSync(p,'utf8'):'';if(!/autoRenew: false/.test(r('lib/sites/domain-purchase.ts'))){console.error('SCAN-837: a purchased domain auto-renews at Vercel outside the renewal sweep');process.exit(1)}"
